inps.edc.origin: National Institute for Social Security - INPS
inps.edc.userinfo:
###### European Disability Card (EDC)
The European Disability Card is available to holders who have been recognised with a civil disability rating of 67% or above, or who receive the attendance allowance pursuant to Law 18/1980.

The digital card is equivalent to the physical version for the purpose of accessing benefits in countries participating in the European EDC programme. For information on applicable benefits, visit the [INPS portal](https://www.inps.it).
inps.name: National Institute for Social Security - INPS
m_ef.ehic.userinfo:
###### Health Card - European Health Insurance Card (EHIC)
The card is available to all Italian citizens enrolled in the National Health Service (NHS - *Servizio Sanitario Nazionale*). The digital document includes both the Italian Health Card data and the European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) information.

The EHIC is valid for accessing healthcare services in European Union countries, the European Economic Area, and Switzerland. The validity date is indicated in the document. For renewals or error reports, please contact your local health authority (ASL).

m_inf.mdl.origin: MIT - Direzione generale per la Motorizzazione
m_inf.mdl.userinfo:
###### Mobile Driving Licence (mDL)
Mobile Driving Licences are available for licences issued or renewed after 1 January 2020. Licences issued before that date may not be available in digital format. For updates or corrections, please contact your local Civil Motorisation Office (*Ufficio della Motorizzazione Civile*).

All standard categories (e.g. AM, A1, A2, A, B1, B, BE, C1, C1E, C, CE, D1, D1E, D, DE) are supported. Restriction codes and annotations are included.

m_it.pid.origin: ANPR - National Registry of the Resident Population
m_it.pid.userinfo:
###### Person Identification Data 
Data is sourced from the National Register of the Resident Population (ANPR - *Anagrafe Nazionale della Popolazione Residente*). It is available for all Italian citizens registered in the national civil registry.

Recent demographic changes (name change, corrections) may require the relevant Municipality to complete the update in ANPR before the new data becomes available in the digital credential.
m_it.residency.userinfo:
###### What you will find
A digital version of your residence certificate issued by your municipality is available, with data updated through the National Register of Resident Population (ANPR).

###### How to use your residence certificate
You can present the certificate as an officially valid document to public administrations and private entities that require it.
m_pi.edu_att.userinfo:
###### What you will find
A digital version of your attendance certificate for the current school year is available at state and private schools of all levels, including Provincial Centres for Adult Education (CPIA).

Data relating to pre-school and Ladin- and German-language schools in the Autonomous Province of Bolzano are not included.
m_pi.edu_dip.userinfo:
###### What you'll find
Diploma certificates obtained **from the 2014/2015 school year onwards** are available for all state and private lower and upper secondary schools, including first-level education pathways.

Data relating to Ladin- and German-language schools in the Autonomous Province of Bolzano are not included.
m_pi.name: MIM - Ministry of Education and Merit
mur.edu_deg.origin: ANIS - National Registry of Higher Education
mur.edu_deg.userinfo:
###### Degree qualifications
Available qualifications include those awarded from the **2010/2011 academic year** onwards by Italian higher education institutions:
- Universities
- Higher institutes for art, music and dance education
- Higher schools for language mediators
- Specialization schools in psychotherapy

###### Postgraduate qualifications
Qualifications awarded under the new academic system and postgraduate qualifications are available from the **2017/2018 academic year** onwards.

For some institutions, degree or postgraduate qualifications awarded before 2010 may also be available.
mur.edu_enr.origin: ANIS - National Registry of Higher Education
mur.edu_enr.userinfo:
###### What you will find
Digital versions of current academic enrollment certificates are available for students enrolled at the following Italian higher education institutions:
- Universities
- Higher institutes for art, music and dance education
- Higher schools for language mediators
- Specialization schools in psychotherapy

###### How to use enrollment certificates
You can present them as official proof of your current academic enrollment, with full legal validity.
